stance: Web Bot Auth remains in an author-driven tightening phase where its reference implementation is aggressively hardening cryptographic constraints to match draft-00.
adoption_shape: Momentum is strictly concentrated in Cloudflare maintaining its Go Caddy reference plugin, showing that validation logic is being refined internally before seeing visible adoption from third-party server vendors.
new_entrants: No new external vendors have arrived; rather, Cloudflare's reference maintainers have asserted stricter control by enforcing draft-00 tagging, mandatory signature parameters, cryptographic coverage of Signature-Agent headers, and an outright rejection of HMAC signatures.
watch_for: An upstream fix in the Go HTTP message signature library for the documented parsing bug where dictionary members of the Signature-Agent header fail verification.
